title: Refactor URI System
description:
Refactor the URI system to match the new specification.
The uri system (mcp, rest, rdf) is:

repo: `composerepo://` e.g. `composerepo://` 
years: `composerepo://years` e.g. `composerepo://years` 
year: `composerepo://year/{{YY}}` e.g. `composerepo://year/26` 
months: `composerepo://months/{{YY}}` e.g. `composerepo://months/26` 
month: `composerepo://month/{{YY}}/{{MM}}` e.g. `composerepo://month/26/02` 
days: `composerepo://days/{{YY}}/{{MM}}` e.g. `composerepo://days/26/02` 
day: `composerepo://day/{{YY}}/{{MM}}/{{DD}}` e.g. `composerepo://day/26/02/15` 
hours: `composerepo://hours/{{YY}}/{{MM}}/{{DD}}` e.g. `composerepo://hours/26/02/15` 
hour: `composerepo://hour/{{YY}}/{{MM}}/{{DD}}/{{HH}}` e.g. `composerepo://hour/26/02/15/14` 
minutes: `composerepo://minutes/{{YY}}/{{MM}}/{{DD}}/{{HH}}` e.g. `composerepo://minutes/26/02/15/14` 
minute: `composerepo://minute/{{YY}}/{{MM}}/{{DD}}/{{HH}}/{{mm}}` e.g. `composerepo://minute/26/02/15/14/33` 
seconds: `composerepo://seconds/{{YY}}/{{MM}}/{{DD}}/{{HH}}/{{mm}}` e.g. `composerepo://seconds/26/02/15/14/33` 
second: `composerepo://second/{{YY}}/{{MM}}/{{DD}}/{{HH}}/{{mm}}/{{SS}}` e.g. `composerepo://second/26/02/15/14/33/38` 
projects: `composerepo://projects` e.g. `composerepo://projects` 
project: `composerepo://project/{{project-id}}` e.g. `composerepo://project/repo` 
bundles: `composerepo://bundles/{{project-id}}` e.g. `composerepo://bundles/repo` 
bundle: `composerepo://bundle/{{project-id}}/{{bundle-code}}` e.g. `composerepo://bundle/repo/cli` 
folders: `composerepo://folders/{{uri-encoded-parent-path?*}}` e.g. `composerepo://folders/compose/js` 
folder: `composerepo://folder/{{uri-encoded-path*}}` e.g. `composerepo://folder/compose/js/sketchpad` 
files: `composerepo://files/{{uri-encoded-parent-path?*}}` e.g. `composerepo://files/compose/js/sketchpad` 
file: `composerepo://file/{{uri-encoded-file-path*}}` e.g. `composerepo://file/compose/js/sketchpad/design.tsx` 
lines: `composerepo://lines/{{uri-encoded-file-path*}}` e.g. `composerepo://lines/compose/js/sketchpad/design.tsx` 
line: `composerepo://line/{{uri-encoded-file-path*}}/{{linenumber}}` e.g. `composerepo://line/compose/js/sketchpad/design.tsx/3872` 
ranges: `composerepo://ranges/{{uri-encoded-file-path*}}` e.g. `composerepo://ranges/compose/js/sketchpad/design.tsx` 
range: `composerepo://range/{{uri-encoded-file-path*}}/{{start-linenumber}}/{{end-linenumber}}` e.g. `composerepo://range/compose/js/sketchpad/design.tsx/3872/3875` 
sections: `composerepo://sections/{{uri-encoded-file-path*}}` e.g. `composerepo://sections/compose/js/sketchpad/design.tsx` 
section: `composerepo://section/{{uri-encoded-section-path*}}` e.g. `composerepo://section/compose/js/sketchpad/design.tsx/State%20Management/Design%20Store` 
definitions: `composerepo://definitions/{{uri-encoded-parent-section-path*}}` e.g. `composerepo://definitions/compose/js/sketchpad/design.tsx/State%20Management/Design%20Store` 
definition: `composerepo://definition/{{uri-encoded-definition-path*}}` e.g. `composerepo://definition/compose/js/sketchpad/design.tsx/State%20Management/Design%20Store/createSketchpadStore` 
goals: `composerepo://goals/{{uri-encoded-parent-goal-path?*}}` e.g. `composerepo://goals/r26.02-1` 
goal: `composerepo://goal/{{uri-encoded-goal-path*}}` e.g. `composerepo://goal/r26.02-1/Running%20Sketchpad` 
tickets: `composerepo://tickets/{{uri-encoded-parent-scope?*}}` e.g. `composerepo://tickets/r26.02-1/Running%20Sketchpad` 
ticket: `composerepo://ticket/{{uri-encoded-ticket-path*}}` e.g. `composerepo://ticket/r26.02-1/Running%20Sketchpad/Introduce%20Key%20Guid%20Uri%20Mechanism` 
drafts: `composerepo://drafts/{{uri-encoded-parent-resource-uri?*}}` e.g. `composerepo://drafts/composerepo%3A%2F%2Fbundle%2Frepo%2Fcli` 
draft: `composerepo://draft/{{uri-encoded-parent-resource-uri*}}/{{uri-encoded-draft-title*}}` e.g. `composerepo://draft/composerepo%3A%2F%2Fbundle%2Frepo%2Fcli/New%20Architecture` 
todos: `composerepo://todos/{{uri-encoded-parent-resource-uri?*}}` e.g. `composerepo://todos/composerepo%3A%2F%2Fdefinition%2Fcompose%2Fjs%2Fsketchpad%2Fdesign.tsx%2FState%2520Management%2FDesign%2520Store%2FcreateSketchpadStore` 
todo: `composerepo://todo/{{uri-encoded-parent-resource-uri*}}/{{uri-encoded-todo-title*}}` e.g. `composerepo://todo/composerepo%3A%2F%2Fdefinition%2Fcompose%2Fjs%2Fsketchpad%2Fdesign.tsx%2FState%2520Management%2FDesign%2520Store%2FcreateSketchpadStore/Introduce%20Proper%20Sync%20Mechanism` 
policies: `composerepo://policies/{{uri-encoded-parent-resource-or-kind?*}}` e.g. `composerepo://policies/code` 
policy: `composerepo://policy/{{uri-encoded-parent-resource-or-kind?*}}/{{uri-encoded-policy-name*}}` e.g. `composerepo://policy/code/Godfiles` 
statutes: `composerepo://statutes/{{uri-encoded-policy-path?*}}` e.g. `composerepo://statutes/code/Godfiles` 
statute: `composerepo://statute/{{uri-encoded-policy-path*}}/{{uri-encoded-statute-name*}}` e.g. `composerepo://statute/code/Godfiles/Max%20Lines%20Per%20File` 
breaches: `composerepo://breaches/{{uri-encoded-policy-path?*}}` e.g. `composerepo://breaches/code/Godfiles` 
breach: `composerepo://breach/{{uri-encoded-policy-path*}}/affects/{{uri-encoded-affected-resource-uri*}}/at/{{uri-encoded-location-uri*}}/when/{{uri-encoded-second-path*}}` e.g. `composerepo://breach/code/Godfiles/affects/composerepo%3A%2F%2Ffile%2Fcompose%2Fjs%2Fsketchpad%2Fdesign-store.ts/at/composerepo%3A%2F%2Frange%2Fcompose%2Fjs%2Fsketchpad%2Fdesign-store.ts%2F3872-3875/when/composerepo%3A%2F%2Fsecond%2F26%2F02%2F14%2F19%2F07%2F12` 
contributors: `composerepo://contributors` e.g. `composerepo://contributors` 
contributor: `composerepo://contributor/{{uri-encoded-contributor-name*}}` e.g. `composerepo://contributor/usalu` 
commits: `composerepo://commits` e.g. `composerepo://commits` 
commit: `composerepo://commit/{{uri-encoded-commit-sha*}}` e.g. `composerepo://commit/cfb3b6084ff3fe883d5f39b08810a0b90997907a` 
interactions: `composerepo://interactions` e.g. `composerepo://interactions` 
interaction: `composerepo://interaction/when/{{uri-encoded-second-path*}}/on/{{uri-encoded-entity-uri*}}/{{interaction-kind}}/by/{{uri-encoded-contributor-name*}}` e.g. `composerepo://interaction/when/composerepo%3A%2F%2Fsecond%2F26%2F02%2F14%2F19%2F07%2F12/on/composerepo%3A%2F%2Fticket%2Fr26.02-1%2FRunning%2520Sketchpad%2FIntroduce%2520Key%2520Guid%2520Uri%2520Mechanism/started/by/usalu`
